description: PacIOOS Pacific Islands Ocean Observing System is a data repository run by University of Hawaii, PacIOOS. PacIOOS provides ocean observation and model data for the US-affiliated Pacific islands and beyond: waves, currents, tides, sea level, water quality and coastal hazard information, through a data service with downloads. Coverage: Hawaii, US-affiliated and other Pacific islands. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as netcdf, opendap, csv; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Pacific Islands Ocean Observing System (PacIOOS)") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support coastal hazard studies for Pacific island ports and roads. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
